rows.en: Gaddess... is she communicating through quantum brainwaves...? Who is she talking to?
You lot... I'll let you off this time.
But we have "Gundam Epyon" on our side. You'd do well to remember that.
Gundam Epyon...!! He's one of you!? Why!?
Heh... Veda has the data of every world installed in it...
Data of pure "power," that is.
Pure power?
Yes. Data of pure "power," without any of that troublesome nonsense like a sense of justice.
In other words, we can easily repurpose even the "power" that was originally yours.
Epyon will be the first of many, and it'll drive you all into the depths of despair!!
Gundam Epyon...!!
That's right... Veda has the data of every world installed in it...
Data of pure "power," that is.
Pure power?
Yes. Data of pure "power," without any of that troublesome nonsense like a sense of justice.
In other words, we can easily repurpose even the "power" that was originally yours.
Epyon will be the first of many, and it'll drive you all into the depths of despair!!
Who was she talking to? With that... quantum brainwave thing.
...!! A Virgo... There were still some left!?
...Looks like it's gone silent.
So the operation was a success.
...Another one. Their numbers are huge. A head-on fight with them is a chilling thought.
Isn't there anything we can do!!
It's no use... It won't accept any commands.
This room is...
Oh, Seravee! Thanks to you guys, we made it past the Virgo squad.
Looks like this room controls the Cube's facilities.
I see. Then we can stop the particle cannon from firing.
That's the thing, we can't. The particle cannon's remote control systems are all blocked.
This is bad... The energy charge has passed 50%.
Damn... We're out of time. We'll have to get to the particle cannon's control room and stop it directly.
Where is it?
I scanned the Cube's structure. I've got a rough idea where it is.
Then we might be able to pull this off.
All right, let's go right away.
No, Seravee, you go to the Terminal Unit. It should give us a foothold for retaking Veda.
The Terminal Unit...!? You found it!?
Yeah. It turns out it's on the floor below this one, the "Middle Layer."
{8074}, I want you to head to the Middle Layer with Seravee first.
Then search for the Terminal Unit. As soon as you find it, Seravee will try to access Veda.
Worst case, even if our team fails, we can still stop the launch through Veda.
Understood.
Mission accepted.
Got it.
Roger that.
Roger!!
Leave it to us!!
Okay, understood.
Roger that.
Understood.
Understood.
Okay, understood.
All right, consider it handled!!
Yeah! Just leave it to me!!
Roger!!
Roger!!
Hey, what's this "Terminal Unit" thing?
It's a terminal room with access to Veda's main body. We should find some kind of info there.
Hmph, I see.
Oh, that's right, Ankh. I'll give you this...
It's a communicator. Let's keep in contact with each other as we go.
So I'm the message boy, huh!?
Ah, no, that's not what I meant...
...Tch. Fine, I'll take it on.
Obtained the "Communicator".
Right, let's hurry!! Sandrock!! We're going to the particle cannon's control room!!
Cherudim and the others left the room.
We need to hurry too! First, we head for the Middle Layer.
Your destination has been marked on the MAP.
Beyond here is Cherudim's team's sector. There's no need for us to go there yet.
Let's keep exploring through the door on the other side.
...What's that noise?
The way this vibration and sound are carrying... It's coming from outside.
Outside? Outside the Cube?
...There it is again!
It's more violent than before...
Whoa, we can't let you go any farther, you know?
Still, making it this far is quite impressive.

notes.note: Rows 0.41-0.64 cover two branches (Wing Zero in party: 0.46-0.52; otherwise Seravee: 0.56-0.62); identical lines kept identical. Brain quantum waves rendered 'quantum brainwaves' per glossary/earlier slices.
Gaddess is receiving orders over brainwaves (end of 0.40), hence the withdrawal.
Heero refers to Epyon as 'yatsu'; used 'he' (glossary Epyon g=m).
'sakigake' = vanguard/forerunner: 'the first of many'. Epyon referred to as 'it' as a power-data copy.
Ankh refers to Gaddess as 'she' (glossary g=f).
Literal 'so there were still some'; refers to remaining Virgo units after the mobile doll control device was destroyed.

Leader block 0.22-0.36 mapped from Pt_Chara_Check order 10,9,8,6,7,15,14,13,12,11,5,4,3,2,1: 00, Wing Zero, God, Nu, Zeta, Zero, Mebius, Taro, Seven, Ultraman, OOO, W(Shotaro), Den-O Sword, Black RX, Rider 1. Wording fits each (Heero 'Mission accepted', Momotaros rough, Mebius/OOO polite). Identical JP -> identical EN.
Zero speaking for the team; 'Leave it to us!!' matches earlier rendering of the same phrase.
'tsuushin-gakari' = the one in charge of comms; 'message boy' keeps Ankh's indignation.
'Communicator' item is not in ItemName tables; plain rendering.
Gadessa (Revive Revival) speaks for the Innovades; 'we' since Garazzo is with him.

report: 80/80 rows translated. Leader block 0614 #0.22-36 mapped via Pt_Chara_Check order. Terms used: quantum brainwaves, Veda, Terminal Unit (00 term, not in glossary), particle cannon, Middle Layer (matches DungeonName), Communicator (not in glossary), Virgo squad.
